summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.95. Confirmed account takeover for c.aydin@aegean.edu. Baseline is two known devices: dev-ca-laptop on campus AS-AEGEAN-EDU (Manisa) midday and dev-ca-phone on Turkcell AS16135 (Manisa) evenings. On 2026-10-08 at ~22:41-22:44, six consecutive portal login failures came from 192.0.2.61 (AS60068 Datacamp Limited, Frankfurt, DE) via unknown device dev-unk-7f3a, followed immediately by an MFA-approved portal login and successful mail/sis logins from the same Frankfurt IP/device. A mail event at 22:49:02 confirms an OWA forwarding rule to external address c.aydin.ogr@proton.me. Credential brute-force + MFA approval + access from an unfamiliar foreign ASN + exfiltration-style forwarding rule constitute a confirmed compromise requiring containment (disable session, force password reset, revoke MFA, remove forwarding rule, investigate dev-unk-7f3a).
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
